notes: Initial qualification: primary ask = Private VPC deployment in EU only (data residency + audit logs).

Security posture: SOC2 Type II in place, ISO27001 in progress. Customer wants Redwood to surface continuous audit log export to their SIEM (Splunk).

Networking constraints: private endpoints only. No public internet ingress to inference nodes. Prefer PrivateLink/Interface endpoints or AWS Transit Gateway + IPSec to on-prem. Egress only to specific Redwood control-plane IPs via NAT gateways and allowlist.

KMS: customer prefers CMKs in their AWS account (BYOK). Needs documentation for Redwood private control plane to use external KMS/Grant flow or cross-account key usage. Key rotation policy must be visible to BeaconHarbor security.
Retention: legal requires 7-year audit log retention for a subset of logs; service telemetry ok at 90 days. Need retention controls that can be configured per-log-type.
Compliance ask: support for SSO via SAML 2.0 + SCIM for provisioning. Detailed attestation and architecture for audit logging requested.

Architecture notes: propose 3-AZ private subnets for inference nodes with internal NLBs, control plane connectivity via AWS PrivateLink or customer-managed peering; S3 VPC endpoints for model artifacts snapshot storage; VPC Flow Logs to dedicated logging account S3 bucket with lifecycle rules.

Inbound/outbound specifics (draft): inbound = PrivateLink endpoints from customer VPC -> Redwood ingestion plane; outbound = NAT gateway egress to Redwood control-plane allowlist over TLS 1.2+, limited to mTLS where possible.
